image_qa.note: The two article upgrades and the link-integrity trust update use text, tables, forms and existing design components. No product, medical, cultivar, affiliate, stock or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 7–October 4 report showed 1,214 impressions, two clicks, 0.2% CTR, and average position 35.3. Stem Cell CBG had the only supported position 4–20 page signal, with 13 impressions, one click, and position 5.3, and it was materially expanded on October 8. Remaining position 4–20 rows had only one to seven impressions, so no Data-led item was justified; those tiny samples and the isolated Oklahoma-law click were deliberately ignored. Today's work strengthens the broad beginner hub, a distinct purchase-comparison workflow, and technical trust rather than chasing another thin query variation.

authority.action: Rebuilt Cannabis 101 into a citation-worthy product, label, claims, safety, storage and response reference using current CDC, FDA and Poison Control sources; connected it to established label, lot-evidence and responsible-use paths; and documented a sitewide URL-fragment validation gate. No outreach was sent and no new outreach target was logged because strengthening the site's own foundational hub was the higher-value authority action.
